descripcion_geo: Central region of Asia Minor, home of the Galatians (emigrant Celtic tribes). Roman province since 25 BC.
importancia_estrategica: First interior region of Asia Minor evangelized by Paul; recipient of the letter to the Galatians.

historias.titulo: Paul evangelizes Galacia on the first trip
historias.descripcion: Paul and Barnabas found churches in Antioch of Pisidia, Iconium, Lystra and Derbe, cities in the province of Galatia.

historias.titulo: The letter to the Galatians: Christian freedom
historias.descripcion: Paul writes to the churches of Galatia to defend justification by faith against the Judaizers.

historias.titulo: Paul confirms the churches of Galatia
historias.descripcion: On the second voyage, Paul strengthens the disciples of Galatia, visiting the cities founded on the first voyage.

personajes.descripcion: He evangelized Galatia twice; he wrote to them the most polemical and theologically powerful letter in the NT.
Born in Lystra in Galatia; He became Paul's favorite disciple.
He accompanied Paul in the first evangelization of Galatia.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Galatia was the first laboratory of the Pauline mission to the Gentiles; The letter that Paul wrote to them is the great letter of Christian freedom.

cristianismo.descripcion: Faced with the Judaizers who demanded circumcision of the Gentiles, Paul proclaims in Galatians that justification is only by faith in Christ.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: Faced with the Judaizers who demanded circumcision of the Gentiles, Paul proclaims in Galatians that justification is only by faith in Christ.

historias.titulo: The first missionary journey: founding of Galatian churches
historias.descripcion: Paul and Barnabas found the first churches in the interior of Asia Minor in Galatia.
Paul writes the most combative letter in the NT to defend the gospel of grace against the Judeo-Christian teachers.
Paul picks up Timothy, son of a Jewish mother and Greek father, in Lystra in Galatia, for his second journey.

personajes.descripcion: Founder of the Galatian churches; His letter reminds them that they were set free for freedom.
Born in Lystra in Galatia; He grew in faith thanks to the first Pauline journey.
Co-founder of the Galatian churches on the first voyage.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Galatia: crucible of the gospel of grace and faith, free from the law.

cristianismo.descripcion: The letter to the Galatians is the declaration of independence of the gospel against legalism: 'Christ has set us free for freedom' (Gal 5:1).
cristianismo.significado_teologico: The letter to the Galatians is the declaration of independence of the gospel against legalism: 'Christ has set us free for freedom' (Gal 5:1).
